Cada capa aparece unos segundos y se va: Each layer appears for a few seconds and goes away on its own. Click it to edit it below the video: text, style, color, position, size and how long it lasts.
Cada cámara se acerca un poco (hasta un: Each camera zooms in a little (up to 4.5%) when that person's voice energy rises, and settles back smoothly. Brings static cameras to life without touching anything.
Cada cintillo entra abajo a la izquierda: Each lower third enters at the bottom left, stays for the seconds you choose and leaves on its own. Click it to edit it below the video.
Cada momento que marcaste en postPod se: Every moment you marked in postPod becomes a vertical video with subtitles.
Cada persona suena un poco hacia el lado: Each person sounds slightly toward the side they appear on screen (at most 30%). With headphones it's easier to tell who's speaking; on a speaker nobody gets lost.
Cambiar de podcast o crear uno nuevo: Switch podcast or create a new one
Capítulos, invitados y links, listos par: Chapters, guests and links, ready to paste into YouTube or Spotify.
Casi no se oye nada. Revisa que el micró: Almost nothing can be heard. Check that the microphone isn't muted or too far away.
Cámara lenta a la izquierda, acelerado a: Slow motion to the left, sped up to the right. It takes the same seconds on screen; the sound keeps its pitch.
Cámara para la sala y grabación a la vez: Camera for the room and the recording at once
Chasquidos de boca, clics de cable o de: Mouth clicks, cable or keyboard clicks that are very short: detected as abrupt jumps under 2.5 ms and stitched over. No artificial intelligence, and the timbre doesn't change.
Chasquidos y clics de menos de 2,5 ms se: Clicks and pops under 2.5 ms are stitched over before the chain
Chat moderado: lo que escribe el público: Moderated chat: you see what the audience writes first and it goes out when you approve it.
Clic en un clip para editarlo. En la pis: Click a clip to edit it. On the Cameras track, right-click to pin a camera at that second; drag its edges to extend the stretch.
Clic: ir ahí · arrastra un clip para mov: Click: go there · drag a clip to move it · right-click on Cameras: pin
Clic: ir ahí · arrastra: marcar un trozo: Click: go there · drag: mark a stretch · double-click a person: volume point
Clic: usar de portada. Doble clic: ir a: Click: use as cover. Double-click: go to that second.
Como sale a la sala: As it goes out to the room
Compara el brillo y el balance de color: Compares the brightness and color balance at the center of each camera's frame and brings the others closer to the reference (exposure and per-channel gain). You can fine-tune each camera afterwards.
Compresor suave: lo que dice bajito sube: Gentle compressor: quiet speech comes up and shouting doesn't hit hard
Comprueba que la Mac puede entrar a una: Checks that the Mac can join a prodPod room, send your camera and record it in 1080p at the same time. Nothing is recorded on the server.
Con audífonos: se graba tu micrófono dir: With headphones: your microphone is recorded directly.
Con marco de estudio (el fondo del podca: With studio frame (the podcast background behind)
Con menos de este tiempo en una cámara n: With less than this time on a camera there's no switch, so fast conversations don't get choppy.
With speakers: your voice is recorded without echo.

Consola, ecualizador por bandas, compres: Console, multiband EQ, full compressor, de-esser and gate per person. For those who want to go further; everything above keeps working without coming in here.

Corre cada frase a donde suena la voz. N: Moves each sentence to where the voice sounds. Doesn't change the text.
